text:
No hiring option can be put forward yet, because the £400k/year salary limit was not checkable in this run.

- The comparison is **fragile** and rests partly on Olumi-authored estimates; delivery capacity is the most sensitive stated factor, using the adopted **12 productive engineer-months before Q3** assumption.
- The model compared delivery effects, but it could not assess whether any scenario satisfies **annual salary spend < £400k/year**. The limit remains recorded but was excluded from the comparison.
- It also assumed that more progress towards “shipped by Q3” is better; that direction was not explicitly stated.

The needed repair is to specify which measurable cost quantity the £400k/year limit applies to, so it can be aligned with the model rather than its calculated salary-change factor.
